parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates tier-1 traveler exposures: federal ban on gender-identity facilities, visa cable directing refusal where documents cast doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for suspected misrepresentation, and custody practices including hormone removal/conversion therapy and reported immigration-detention abuse. Courts have blocked some orders but allowed passport restrictions, so remedy is partial. Division mitigates materially: no state bathroom/facility or youth-care ban, governor vetoes, and a 2019 order barring discrimination in state services. However there is no statewide anti-discrimination or GI hate-crime protection, local ordinances cover only 21% fully, and federal exposures remain unremedied for visitors. Net: elevated risk, below reduced-risk jurisdictions with working protections, above jurisdictions with statewide bathroom bans.
